executionWindow: F-main unless original inventory explicitly defers entry to after-F-PS5.1

groups.fault: HTTP error, authentication, rate limiting, malformed response
groups.anchor: B 3xx authentication rate limit server failures never retry or read raw errors
groups.required: one call; distinct sanitized failure; no raw body or implicit retry; no mutation

groups.anchor: D diagnostic timeout and ignored cancellation retain transport until actual completion
groups.required: deadline not renewed; retained until actual completion; one disposal

groups.fault: busy admission and active slot retention
groups.anchor: B busy diagnostic does not release or consume another request active slot
groups.required: rejected request cannot release another owner slot or consume retry identity

groups.fault: bounded queue, duplicate IDs, stale mailbox result
groups.required: retain original queue/lifetime budgets, exact context, one delivery and owner guards

groups.fault: late valid response across explicit workflow replacement
groups.anchor: M8.7-D late reply after {mode} cannot enter replacement workflow
groups.required: old retained then drained without receipt; fresh exact send approval; one new receipt/history; old/new identity and byte hashes; final disposal

groups.fault: actual native owner close while AI ignores cancellation
groups.anchor: host close retains all owners until AI drain and forbids resumed frames
groups.required: same Editor/GUI/renderer/window/physics retained, no resumed frame/recovery, one final close; not independent apphost acceptance

groups.anchor: normal close failure retains dependencies until explicit retry
groups.required: revoke before cleanup; no implicit retry; explicit retry releases in reverse order

groups.fault: outer owner retained with closed extension group
groups.anchor: M8.5-C outer retained survives closed extension group and clears only after host retry
groups.required: outer and extension counts remain distinct; passive diagnostic does not retry or mutate history

groups.fault: root exit is not process tree drain
groups.anchor: M8.6-C2a root exit is not descendant drain timeout cancel preserve first outcome
groups.required: keep first timeout/cancel outcome; retain owner until drain; no proof of real SDK descendant behavior

groups.fault: import worker crash, malformed result and identity mismatch
groups.anchor: Worker crash, malformed output/model and integrity failure cannot publish
groups.required: no publication, exact diagnostic, completed cleanup; preserve original timeout and all case results

groups.fault: actual combined AI+extension host retained by ignored cancellation
groups.required: same actual group Running then Closed before AI drain; extension detached/revoked, inner0/outertrue; retained downstream owners; passive actual presenter labels and unchanged history/bytes; after explicit completed close inner0/outerfalse; one transport disposal; no resumed frames or apphost acceptance

attributionPolicy.caseResult: original CaseHarness terminal result including finally; M87-FAULT markers alone never pass
attributionPolicy.missingDependency: fail or not-run with original denominator; never skip then pass
attributionPolicy.timeout: preserve original timeout and partial reached cases; unknown unless exact cause independently evidenced
attributionPolicy.environmentBlocked: requires per-entry evidence of external prerequisite; retain original raw failure; never classify all apphost/native failures together
attributionPolicy.combinedProof: both original case terminal passes from ai-extensions plus D11 retained/closed markers for cpu and dx11; AI-only pass cannot substitute
attributionPolicy.nativeFailure: retain CPU and DX11 independently; CPU success cannot imply DX11 or independent EXE success
attributionPolicy.cleanupFailure: whole case fails even after earlier successful assertions; retain exact owned process identity and request approval when normal stop fails
attributionPolicy.extensionCloseFailure: D07/D08 original fault fixtures only; D11 tests healthy extension close with retained AI, NOT injected extension failure in real combined host

remainingPreparation: D1/D2 cases are prepared only; replace all whole-stage inputs with matching captured products and receipts and generate fresh original CTest inventory before F
Explicitly retain independent apphost/environment and manual C3-08 gates; no source-level mapping implies those passed
E: bounded measurement/long-run plan before fresh whole input preparation and F
